title: PAD LOST AND PRESS A
why: J8: a pad gap was only handled by a focus dependent event, the box promised a resume it did not perform, and another pad could take its slot.
now: A lost pad pauses its own window. Its slot stays reserved, the other window keeps running with a small loss tag, and physical A resumes when that slot returns.
